create_repo: create a new repository on the Hugging Face Hub with optional visibility, type, and Space configuration
duplicate_repo: duplicate an existing repository on the Hugging Face Hub to a new destination with optional settings
delete_repo: delete a repository from the Hugging Face Hub with confirmation and optional missing-ok behavior
manage_branches: create and delete branches for a repository on the Hugging Face Hub
manage_tags: create, list, and delete tags for a repository on the Hugging Face Hub
